--- docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
+++ docs/kit/02-api-reference.md
@@ -215,8 +215,26 @@
 
 Slots current GET, successful validation, PUT and rollback add `pinDiagnostics: {schema: 'slot-pin-diagnostics/v1', advisory: true, status, slotsRevision, catalog: {source, revision}, checkedAt, warningCount, omittedWarningCount, warnings}`. A candidate has null `slotsRevision`; a successful write diagnoses its exact returned document, without rereading slots. An authorized explicit document with no pins is `not_required` with catalog `not_read`, null catalog revision/time and zero counts; it is not checked-catalog assurance. Legacy GET fallback, missing/corrupt/uninitialized catalog or optional-read failure reports `unavailable` with null counts/list/catalog revision/time. New catalog reads require typed canonical-tenant catalog authority in every auth mode and exact equality with the slot document scope; unbound legacy selectors report unavailable without catalog I/O, preserving the original slot operation.
 
-Available pin feedback names the strict uncached committed catalog revision and observation time. At most50 samples use zero-based `pageIndex`/`slotIndex` and `reason: missing_piece | slot_type | currently_ineligible`; total/omitted counts include all warning occurrences, and no pin IDs or page/slot names are echoed. Current eligibility uses lifecycle, publish window and stock. These warnings do not block scheduled, draft, missing or temporarily unavailable pins, rewrite documents, or invent fallback/exclusion policy. The existing Rules screen shows current/draft checks and the original save response; History retains the original rollback response summary with a Rules link. Catalog and slots remain independent: a later catalog change can invalidate a pin, runtime refusal/reservation remains authoritative, and feedback is neither an atomic activation guarantee nor persisted receipt metadata. Historical reads and generic library writers are unchanged.
+Available pin feedback names the strict uncached committed catalog revision and observation time. At most50 samples use zero-based `pageIndex`/`slotIndex` and `reason: missing_piece | slot_type | currently_ineligible | off_limits | excluded`; total/omitted counts include all warning occurrences, and no pin IDs or page/slot names are echoed. Hard off-limits/exclusion gates apply in addition to lifecycle, publish window, stock and slot-type eligibility, before pins and ranking. These warnings do not block scheduled, draft, missing or temporarily unavailable pins or rewrite documents. The existing Rules screen shows current/draft checks and the original save response; History retains the original rollback response summary with a Rules link. Catalog and slots remain independent: a later catalog change can invalidate a pin, runtime refusal/reservation remains authoritative, and feedback is neither an atomic activation guarantee nor persisted receipt metadata.
 
+Current slot validation/publication emits `governanceVersion: 1` and accepts optional per-slot
+`offLimits` and exact `excludedPieceIds` controls ([schema](./03-payload-schemas.md#hard-slot-controls)).
+Off-limits slots return no engine candidates, decisions or records on any arm, including pinned
+slots; their pin and ranking settings remain dormant. Excluded IDs cannot reach scoring, exploration
+or diversity, and an active excluded pin is rejected at publication. No arbitrary replacement is
+chosen. Rules edits these controls through the existing validate/save/readback and History rollback.
+Missing or unreadable service slot configuration now yields no selections (`sources.slots` is
+`{version:null,revision:0,count:0}`), not compiled slots; the authoring API still offers defaults for
+explicit publication. Existing caches and non-atomic slot writes remain: this is not immediate
+activation or a customer-default rendering guarantee.
+
+New receipts independently carry `inputs.replay.governance: "slot-gates-v1"`; absence retains old
+selection, including compiled zero-version slot replay. Unknown explicit markers refuse. Off-limits
+manifest rows keep page order with zero lift/prior and require no archives. Old unversioned stored
+documents ignore formerly unknown hard-control fields; version-1 stored documents validate them.
+Deploy compatible readers/workers/UI before publishing controls: old binaries can ignore them, so
+binary rollback after governed publication needs explicit operator withdrawal of controls first.
+
 Two more for the catalog, both requiring the operator token, the seam your content system connects to:
 
 | Route | Body | Does |

+++ docs/kit/03-payload-schemas.md
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@
 | `arm` | `personalized`, or the holdout's `default` or `no_learning` |
 | `explored` | True when exploration served it on purpose |
 | `authority` | `engine`, `pin` or `default` |
-| `versions` | `config`, `catalog`, `slots`, `learn`, `lift`, `prior`, `policy`: the revision of each input, 0 for a compiled default. What a replay reads back |
+| `versions` | `config`, `catalog`, `slots`, `learn`, `lift`, `prior`, `policy`: the revision of each input. Zero names an absent/compiled input; current absent slots yield no selections. What a replay reads back |
 | `config_label` | The human-readable label of the configuration revision |
 | `featured_product_ids` | The products the served piece features, when it names any: an outcome naming one of them credits this decision under the default policy, and a warehouse joins it to the product decision |
 | `explain.score_base` | The score before learning: interests times weights, plus the population prior and your model's term when they applied |
@@ -139,6 +139,36 @@
 corrected. Existing revision preconditions and exact-request retries still apply. This contract does
 not normalize registry/case/type aliases, locale, empty-taxonomy policy or product-attribute inheritance.
 
+### Hard slot controls
+
+```json
+{
+  "governanceVersion": 1,
+  "pages": { "home": [
+    { "slot": "hero", "take": 1, "weights": {}, "excludedPieceIds": ["cnt-example"] },
+    { "slot": "legal", "take": 1, "weights": {}, "offLimits": true }
+  ] }
+}
+```
+
+Current slot writes accept an absent marker or `governanceVersion: 1` and emit version 1; any other
+explicit version refuses. `offLimits` is an optional boolean; true hands the slot to the site's own
+default on every arm, without candidates, decisions or records. A dormant pin and all other settings
+are retained. Re-enabling must pass active pin take/uniqueness/exclusion validation.
+`excludedPieceIds` is an optional JSON array of up to 1000 distinct exact internal catalog IDs,
+each 1–1024 UTF-16 units: no trimming, case conversion, customer-ID alias or tag expression.
+Absent/false/[] are neutral. Unknown IDs are harmless; explicit nulls and duplicates refuse.
+Exclusions apply before pins and every ranking hook; diversity never relaxes them. An excluded
+active pin is contradictory. Off-limits or excluded pins reserve nothing for other slots, and a
+refused pin receives no arbitrary fill. No fallback asset or customer slot list is inferred.
+
+Stored documents without the marker retain legacy parsing and ignore these formerly unknown fields;
+version-1 stored documents validate them strictly. Receipts use an independent
+`replay.governance: "slot-gates-v1"` marker; absent means historical selection, not current enforcement.
+Rules offers an exact JSON-array editor, off-limits switch, validation and existing version/rollback
+feedback. Caches, multi-document atomicity, mixed-binary rollout and customer rendering acceptance
+remain separate: a saved revision is not proof every serving worker already observes its controls.
+
 ### Content format affinity
 
 `type` remains the rendering kind. For a known `contentId`, both event hosts learn the held tenant
